newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk makes case in N.Y. Times ad.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk makes case in N.Y. Times ad.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp urged Conrail Inc shareholders on Wednesday to vote against certain Conrail proposals.
Norfolk Southern's latest message to holders was contained in a full-page advertisement in the New York Times on Wednesday.

Norfolk Southern told holders to reject the provisions in the Conrail-CSX merger plan that would "opt out" of Pennsylvania's fair value statute and that would adjourn the special meeting scheduled for January 17.
The company said that its all-cash bid of $10.5 billion, or $115 per share, for Conrail was "superior" to the rival offer from CSX Corp of $9.3 billion.
